But if a user creates the Unix domain socket outside of these abstractions, the user will need to remove it. The same applies when a Node.js API creates a Unix domain socket but the program then crashes. In short, a Unix domain socket will be visible in the file system and will persist until unlinked. On Linux, You can use Unix abstract socket by adding `\0` to the beginning of the path, such as `\0abstract`. The path to the Unix abstract socket is not visible in the file system and it will disappear automatically when all open references to the socket are closed.
